dj g..bio: Dublin-born, New York-based DJ, curator and organizer; runs Nowadays in Ridgewood; deep, dubbed-out atmospheres, seductive grooves and psychedelic textures.
dj g..name: DJ G.

dj saliva.bio: Moniker of Portuguese-born, Berlin-based artist Mauro Ventura; Herrensauna resident and founder of Porto's Arena Spa Superiora; playful, hedonistic sets across electro, techno and breaks.
dj saliva.name: Dj Saliva

elif.bio: Istanbul-born, Barcelona-based DJ and producer; emotive melodic house and techno with hypnotic energy; founder of the Marginalia label.
elif.name: ELIF

esther silex.bio: Cologne-based DJ and producer; unpredictable sets weaving techno, house, soul, funk, afro and disco; debut Pachamama EP on Studio Barnhus.
esther silex.name: Esther Silex

eugenia.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and curator of The Shape of Memory mix series; co-founder of the queer-femme DIY rave LUSH; bright, tender, genre-hopping dance sets.
eugenia.name: Eugenia

frank & tony.bio: Brooklyn deep house duo Francis Harris and Anthony Collins; co-founders of the Scissor & Thread label and residents of public records.
frank & tony.name: Frank & Tony

genesi.bio: Italian DJ and producer (Giovanni Bottai) whose breakout track 'Everything You Have Done' with MEDUZA topped Beatport and neared 100 million streams.
genesi.name: GENESI

hamadi.bio: NYC-based DJ (real name Mohamed) playing underground sets at Mood Ring, Nowadays, and Bossa Nova Civic Club.
hamadi.name: Hamadi

hank jackson.bio: NYC-based DJ and producer; founder of the anno label; known for trippy, genre-blurring sets and releases on Proibito and Mister Saturday Night.
hank jackson.name: Hank Jackson

hazzi.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ playing local sets including Jupiter Disco's 'Ear, Nose + Throat' nights.
hazzi.name: hazzi

hugo.bio: NYC selector and feedbk regular; deep and ethereal strain of house and techno.
hugo.name: Hugo

j. richards.bio: NYC-based DJ and vinyl selector; co-founder and Director of Programming at Signal; draws from 90s and 00s house, progressive, trance and tech house plus acid, electro, minimal and techno; releases on Ukraine's Tvir label.
j. richards.name: J. Richards

jdh.bio: New York DJ and half of JDH & Dave P, the duo behind the long-running FIXED party; resident at Brooklyn's Good Room; plays house, disco and techno.
jdh.name: JDH

lovecraft.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ, producer and live act; core member of the ZERO community; performs original live sets incorporating electric guitar; has played Brooklyn Mirage, Kater Blau and Burning Man camps.
lovecraft.name: Lovecraft

marcel dettmann.bio: Berlin DJ and producer; longtime Berghain resident; runs Marcel Dettmann Records and Bad Manners; one of the most influential proponents of contemporary techno.
marcel dettmann.name: Marcel Dettmann

masa saji.bio: Berlin-based Japanese DJ and producer; underground house and techno, with remixes on Xternal Records and SCSI-9's Randomart.
masa saji.name: Masa Saji

morenxxx.bio: Brooklyn-based interdisciplinary artist, DJ and producer from Chicago's underground; hypnotic, fast, heavily percussive sets blending techno, trance, house and vocals.
morenxxx.name: MORENXXX

rafaelo.bio: Born in Guatemala and based in Berlin; blends Latin American, Ibiza, eastern European, Frankfurt and Berlin influences into a unique style.
rafaelo.name: RAFAELO

roman fl\u00fcgel.bio: Producer and DJ active since the early 90s; chameleon across house, techno, electro and leftfield; co-founded Playhouse and Klang Elektronik labels.
roman fl\u00fcgel.name: Roman Flügel

samuel fish.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and Outer Orbit boss; focuses on deeper sides of house and techno alongside disco and dub.
samuel fish.name: Samuel Fish

samwise (us).bio: LA-bred, Brooklyn-based DJ and co-founder/resident of Fast At Work; intuitive selector moving between emotional intensity, lightness and introspection.
samwise (us).name: Samwise

scotia.bio: Upstate New York DJ and producer; acid-centered sets and hardware productions informed by proto-house, electro and 80s freestyle; records on The Bunker, Delft, Chinotto and Acid Camp
scotia.name: Scotia

simisola.bio: Brooklyn-based Nigerian DJ (fka sola system); eclectic Black diasporic selections spanning shimmery house, global bass and deconstructed club; cofounder of ABEG NYC and SLICK DOWN
simisola.name: Simisola

simzii.bio: Haifa-based Palestinian DJ and producer (Sami Zreik); driving techno blended with dreamy trance and Arabic pop nostalgia; debut EP Yours Truly on Permission to Dance
simzii.name: Simzii

steve challier.bio: Berlin DJ and producer (aka IVO); eclectic house sets with releases like Cosmic EP and Space Jelly EP; played Tresor, Kater Blau and Malzfabrik
steve challier.name: Steve Challier

succubass.bio: Seattle DJ (Jess Duran); genre-unbound sets spanning house, techno, acid and bass; TUF and High + Tight member with Panorama Bar and Berghain bookings
succubass.name: Succubass

tagof.bio: New York-based producer; club-built dance tracks spanning 128 to 178 BPM; self-released Toolshed Vol. 1 and Memoryless via Bandcamp
tagof.name: Tagof

welker.bio: California-based Brazilian producer; tech house with Latin and Afro influences; support from Solomun and Vintage Culture; releases on 1001 Recordings and IN / ROTATION
welker.name: WELKER

babeitspurr.bio: NYC DJ (alias PURR); open-format global club sets spanning amapiano, techno, jungle, baile funk and gqom, rooted in queer and Black dancefloor traditions.
babeitspurr.name: BABEITSPURR

bella mode.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and producer from Grand Rapids, MI; plays electro, breaks, house, techno and psy; released original singles in 2025.
bella mode.name: Bella Mode

bubucore69.bio: NYC-based DJ, producer and vtuber; plays j-core, happy hardcore and hard dance at anime con raves; releases on Bandcamp as SIPPING OUT OF CUPS and SPACE VS.
bubucore69.name: BUBUCORE69

c4.bio: DJ and producer from Pereira, Colombia; fast, raw, unfiltered techno with the CRUD0 collective, playing Brooklyn floors like SILO.
c4.name: C4

mohajer.bio: Berlin-based Swedish-Persian DJ and producer; groovy techno, tribal house and driving trance with Persian percussive roots; Fast Forward resident and cofounder of queer party series mp3.
mohajer.name: Mohajer

super wav.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ (Corey Hindin); eclectic sets spanning house, breaks, bass and jazz; plays NYC spots including Jupiter Disco, Rash and Crossroads Cafe

veralyn.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and producer playing techno and house across NYC clubs including Bossa Nova Civic Club and Paragon; founder of the Synth Wars DJ competition.
veralyn.name: Veralyn

cassandrah.bio: Italian DJ and producer launched in 2021; sets blend industrial techno sounds, dark atmospheres and breakcore influences; performed at MONASTERIO and BLACKWORKS.
cassandrah.name: cassandrah

charmed.bio: New York-based b2b DJ duo Charmed, the joint project of BABEITSPURR and KC (NYC), plays bass, dubstep, breaks and jungle in their club sets.

dj three.bio: Florida-born, NYC-based DJ; veteran of US house and techno since the early 90s; founder of the Hallucienda label, formerly Hallucination Limited.
dj three.name: DJ Three

duco.bio: NYC-based DJ/producer originally from Seoul; founder of the PAN!C ROOM collective; plays hardgroove techno, hard house, ghettotech and breakbeat.
duco.name: duco

gigi rio.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ; genre-bending sets spanning UKG, bassline, breaks and minimal; host of the Unravel party and mix series.
gigi rio.name: Gigi Rio

iluvonionz.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and Club Akira collective member; plays techno and club sets at NYC venues including Rash, Jupiter Disco, Mood Ring and Elsewhere.
iluvonionz.name: Iluvonionz

kc (nyc).bio: Brooklyn-based DJ playing house, hardgroove, techno and drum and bass; blends multiple genres in each set; founder and curator of the Born 2 Boogie dance party.
kc (nyc).name: KC (NYC)

miss parker.bio: Brooklyn-based queer non-binary DJ, producer and promoter whose vinyl sets span trance, techno, acid and hardstyle; runs the Oasis series at Nowadays and has played Boiler Room and HOR Berlin.
miss parker.name: Miss Parker

mui mui.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ, organizer and classically trained dancer who runs the Techno Casa party series and holds residencies on Noods Radio and Hong Kong Community Radio, playing bass-driven techno and club sets.
mui mui.name: Mui Mui

nightvvitch.bio: Bronx-born Nuyorican DJ and multimedia artist rooted in NYC's goth, industrial and EBM scenes; dark, hypnotic sets that keep the groove, released the Moonlight & Teeth demo in 2021.
nightvvitch.name: NIGHTVVITCH

sister zo.bio: New York-based DJ and producer (real name Zoey Shopmaker) blending UK bass, percussive broken beats and driving techno; releases on 3024 and Scuffed Recordings; co-founder of the UN/TUCK collective.
sister zo.name: Sister Zo

waddle.bio: Seoul-born, NYC-based DJ and producer (Sam Chung), a classically trained cellist whose open-format sets range from deep/tech house to hard dance, donk and ghetto tech; co-founder of the PAN!C ROOM collective.
waddle.name: WADDLE

xsb-r.bio: Brooklyn native Henry Chen's electronic music project channeling NYC goth, industrial and dark techno; founder of the TUNNELWERK acid/EBM/noise party series and the Cafe Reflexion darkwave coffee sessions.
xsb-r.name: XSB-R

y2aura.bio: NYC DJ (real name Auralee) and one-fifth of the PAN!C ROOM collective; brings driving techno, gritty bass and club music to Brooklyn parties including Bossa Nova Civic Club and Mood Ring.
y2aura.name: y2aura

1morning.name: 1morning
1morning.bio: Los Angeles-based vinyl DJ and producer; funky old-school techno and hardgroove with swung '90s grooves; releases on Fixed Rhythms, Ilian Tape, Character and ARTS.

adam x.name: Adam X
adam x.bio: Brooklyn-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer; NYC techno pioneer since 1990; Sonic Groove Records founder; merges techno with industrial and EBM.

ah dek.name: Ah Dek
ah dek.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and hardware techno performer active since 2010; plays NYC underground spots like Bossa Nova Civic Club and Jupiter Disco; makes club edits.

anika kunst.name: Anika Kunst
anika kunst.bio: Spanish (Granada-born, Barcelona-based) DJ, producer and Chapter Records founder; 20+ years; raw, groovy, hypnotic techno.

balam.name: Balam
balam.bio: Buenos Aires producer and DJ on Multi Culti, Hard Fist, Calypso and Natural Selections; tribal percussion and folkloric samples meet modular synths in psychedelic, disco-leaning dancefloor pressure.

byron yeates.name: Byron Yeates
byron yeates.bio: Berlin-based DJ and producer from Galway, Ireland; founder of party-turned-label Radiant Records and co-founder of La Noche; plays long sets of cosmic techno, celestial acid and deep house.

carlo sine.name: Carlo Sine
carlo sine.bio: New England DJ, producer and Natural Selections co-founder; selections run from disco and cosmic house to punk-infused psych rock; releases on Tour De Infinite, Spa In Disco and Whiskey Pickle.

frankie bones.bio: Brooklyn-born DJ and producer who began playing New York clubs in the early 1980s and organized the first Storm Rave outdoor parties; brother of Adam X, founder of Bangin Music.
frankie bones.name: Frankie Bones

dynoman.name: Dynoman
dynoman.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and producer (Haamid Rahim) from Karachi; techno built on chuggy basslines and South Asian percussion like tabla; cofounder of Forever South, Rare Frequency Transmissions and Tarka.

fran lf.name: Fran LF
fran lf.bio: Sicilian-born, Amsterdam-based DJ and producer; groove-driven hardgroove techno on Quartz, Solid Tracks, NECHTO and his Vibrant Collective; one half of F Theory.

helix.name: Helix
helix.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ (real name Aheli); hard groove, techno and jersey club; plays NYC underground parties like Stoneface Sessions and Bossa Nova Civic Club.

jack marlow.name: JACK MARLOW
jack marlow.bio: Liverpool-based producer; signature blend of house and UK garage with tracks 'Who Do U' and 'Pressure FM'; independent, 1.4M+ Spotify monthly listeners.

concrete husband.name: Concrete Husband
concrete husband.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ, producer, composer and classically trained flutist; releases on White Owl Records and NNA Tapes blend hard groove and industrial techno with chamber composition.

cotton.name: cotton
cotton.bio: Brooklyn-born DJ in the New York underground for 13 years; founder of the Renegade parties; plays driving, raw techno with an exploratory, no-BS approach.

joey beltram.bio: Queens-born DJ and producer; pioneering 1990s techno via the anthems "Energy Flash" and "Mentasm"; releases on R&S, Tresor and Drumcode.
joey beltram.name: Joey Beltram

juana.bio: Chicago-born, DC-based DJ and producer on the Discwoman roster; straight-ahead techno with Chicago acid and deep house roots; co-founder of the NOXEEMA JACKSON collective.
juana.name: Juana

juliana huxtable.bio: New York artist, writer and DJ; founder of the Shock Value party series; genre-blending club sets fusing techno, grime and hip-hop.
juliana huxtable.name: Juliana Huxtable

kamran sadeghi.bio: Iranian-born, NYC-based electronic composer, producer and live performer; hypnotic house and techno via modular synthesis; core member of Soundwalk Collective.
kamran sadeghi.name: Kamran Sadeghi

light asylum.bio: Brooklyn electronic project of vocalist Shannon Funchess, founded 2007; darkwave and synth-pop with operatic contralto vocals; released on Mexican Summer.
light asylum.name: Light Asylum

loren berrier.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and co-founder of the Mobile Output event series; 25 years behind the decks playing house, disco and open-format sets across NYC.
loren berrier.name: Loren Berrier

a.wild.name: A.Wild
a.wild.bio: Bristol-based DJ and electronic producer splitting time with London; debut EP ReportDeluxe on Studio Barnhus; releases on Wisdom Teeth and Outer Heaven Records; mixes minimal, techno and tech house.

alcala.name: Alcala
alcala.bio: Boston-born, NYC-based DJ; started at college house parties with underground progressive house, electro and techno; blurs lines between electro, disco, techno, house and indie.

alex oxley.name: Alex Oxley
alex oxley.bio: LA-based UK-born DJ; co-founder of global touring remix project Fleetmac Wood; runs Horror Hi-Fi, channeling psychedelic electronic music via horror cinema.

chloe battelle.name: Chloe Battelle
chloe battelle.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and producer whose sound merges techno with cinematic melody, drawing on 90s acid, breakbeat and early rave; debut EP 'Porcelain' on EELF Records; founder of the Softcore party series.

lydo.name: LYDO
lydo.bio: New York-based sound artist and DJ; BASEMENT NY resident; founder of the X-TRA.SERVICES party series and label.

lenny dee.name: Lenny Dee
lenny dee.bio: New York DJ; founder of Industrial Strength Records (1991); pioneer of hardcore techno and gabber; first hardcore DJ to appear in the DJ Mag Top 100.

marsolo.name: Marsolo
marsolo.bio: Dutch house DJ and producer Marijn van Vliet from Utrecht; emotive sample-driven house with vintage drums and warm synths; releases on Eastenderz and Three Six Zero, supported by Chris Stussy and Enzo Siragusa.

natalia roth.name: Natalia Roth
natalia roth.bio: Puerto Rican-born DJ, vocalist and producer based in Miami; fuses minimal tech and techno; resident at Club Space and founder of the Melódie party brand and record label.

pablo bozzi.name: Pablo Bozzi
pablo bozzi.bio: Berlin-based French producer and DJ; Italo Body Music blending italo disco, EBM, synthwave and early trance; half of Imperial Black Unit and Soft Crash; owns Second Sight label.

perc.name: Perc
perc.bio: London-based producer Ali Wells; industrial-leaning techno and founder of the Perc Trax label, active since the early 2000s with albums on Perc Trax and releases on CLR, Drumcode and Kompakt.

shed.name: Shed
shed.bio: Berlin-based German producer René Pawlowitz; dub-inflected techno also released as Head High, Wax and STP; Ostgut Ton and 50 Weapons artist; debut Shedding the Past named RA's 2008 album of the year.

vile.name: VILE
vile.bio: Colombian-born, NYC-based DJ and producer Vile Sánchez; dark, surreal hard techno with goth and cyber aesthetics; 2025 single 'Sinister'; plays Basement and Bossa Nova Civic Club.

volvox.name: Volvox
volvox.bio: NYC-based DJ Ariana Paoletti; tough, stripped-back techno and acid; early Discwoman artist, now runs the FLINTA NYC party series; played Boiler Room, Berghain and De School.

dr. rubinstein.name: Dr. Rubinstein
dr. rubinstein.bio: Russian-born Israeli DJ Marina Rubinstein, Berlin-based since 2012; rave-focused acid techno sets as a vinyl enthusiast and Berghain Klubnacht regular; launched the Uppers & Downers label in 2024

the advent.name: The Advent
the advent.bio: Cisco Ferreira, London-based techno pioneer; released his first track in 1988, formed The Advent with Colin McBean in 1994, runs Kombination Research, regular at Berghain and Tresor

marie davidson.name: Marie Davidson
marie davidson.bio: Montreal-based electronic musician on Ninja Tune; solo albums Working Class Woman (2018) and City of Clowns (2025); half of the minimal wave duo Essaie pas

xeno & oaklander.name: Xeno & Oaklander
xeno & oaklander.bio: Brooklyn minimal electronics duo of Liz Wendelbo and Sean McBride (Martial Canterel); record and perform on analog synthesizers exclusively; albums on Ghostly International and Dais Records

call super.name: Call Super
call super.bio: Joseph Richmond Seaton, London-based producer and DJ; albums Suzi Ecto (2014), Arpo (2017) and Every Mouth Teeth Missing (2020); co-founded the Can You Feel The Sun label; started the ARPO DJ project in 2025

arpo.name: ARPO
arpo.bio: ARPO (A Rhythm Protects One), Call Super's all-night DJ project honouring the mix CD, launched with the mix album A Rhythm Protects One on Dekmantel in 2025

shanti celeste.name: Shanti Celeste
shanti celeste.bio: Chilean-born, London-based DJ and producer; founder of the Peach Discs label; NTS radio host; debut album Tangerine (2019), followed by Romance

funk tribu.name: Funk Tribu
funk tribu.bio: Eduardo José Montañez Sánchez, Bogotá-born, Berlin-based producer; 2021 breakout track Phonky Tribu; debut album Against All Odds (2024); founded the TRIBE label

intergalactic gary.name: Intergalactic Gary
intergalactic gary.bio: John Scheffer, New Zealand-born, The Hague-based DJ mixing since around 1980; formed The Parallax Corporation with I-F and produced the club hit Lift Off; Intergalactic FM regular

soundstream.name: Soundstream
soundstream.bio: Frank Timm, Berlin producer sampling disco and funk loops over hard kicks; also records as Soundhack and with Errorsmith as Smith 'N' Hack; played around 200 sets at Berghain/Panorama Bar

somewhen.name: Somewhen
somewhen.bio: Szymon Rabowicz, Berlin DJ and producer; Berghain resident since 2016; releases on Ostgut Ton, Unterton and R-Label Group; runs the SANA label

notre dame.name: Notre Dame
notre dame.bio: Paris-born producer; breakout track Yumi on Solomun's Diynamic, later released on Innervisions and Cercle; founded the Paranormal Society label in 2025

lauren flax.name: Lauren Flax
lauren flax.bio: Detroit-born, Brooklyn-based DJ and producer; began as a jungle DJ, evolved into techno, house and electro; The Bunker New York member; half of the trip-hop project CREEP

lady harley.name: Lady Harley
lady harley.bio: Rosie McWilliams, NYC DJ influenced by acid house, breaks and dark disco grooves; hosts the Bella Donna party series; regular at Gabriela and Good Room

afem syko.name: Afem Syko
afem syko.bio: Berlin-based DJ and producer; high-paced techno sets blending hypnotic techno, acid and old-school influences; debut release on Kobosil's R Label Group

andi.name: Andi
andi.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ, producer and founder of the dark synth party and label SYNTHICIDE; author of "Some Wear Leather, Some Wear Lace".

falyn.name: FALYN
falyn.bio: Miami-based DJ and producer blending Afro House and Afro Tech; emerged in 2023 and has performed from California to Morocco.

ramyen.name: Ramyen
ramyen.bio: French DJ and producer behind the Mellow concept; releases include "Beach House" and "Polka" with Yarkin Bora on Sapiens.

papyon.name: Papyon
papyon.bio: New York DJ playing house and techno; appeared at Elements Music & Arts Festival and GORDO's New Year's Eve at The Brooklyn Hangar.

98dots.name: 98dots
98dots.bio: Tbilisi-born, Brooklyn-based DJ and promoter; Mutant Radio resident hosting the Rapture Investigation show, playing psychedelic exploratory techno at Bassiani, BASEMENT and Signal NYC.

rumi de baires.name: Rumi de Baires
rumi de baires.bio: Buenos Aires-born, Vienna-based DJ; co-founder of GAZE and A Party Called JACK; blends house, disco, breaks and techno with jazz and Afro-Latin influences; hosts the GEMS radio show.

fka.m4a.name: fka.m4a
fka.m4a.bio: London-born, Berlin-based DJ (Jay Jackson) known for energetic sets blending Italo disco, chunky house, hi-NRG and psychedelic techno; releases include the 'Summer Nostalgia' EP and 'Handbag Ho'.

battygyal.name: Battygyal
battygyal.bio: Bronx-based DJ and writer of Jamaican descent; moves between ambient, dub and bass-heavy club sets at parties like Papi Juice, Body Hack, Lava and Mood Ring.

octi.name: OCTI
octi.bio: Brooklyn techno DJ on PLAY ME TECHNO lineups, sharing bills with SKIN CONTACT, KYRUH, LUN★ and Von.

skin contact.name: SKIN CONTACT
skin contact.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ; raw, industrial techno moving toward hypnotic intensity through 3–4 deck mixing; founder and curator of PLAY ME TECHNO.

sydfalls.name: sydfalls
sydfalls.bio: Chicago-born DJ, producer and hybrid performer now in New York; footwork, techno and diasporic bass traditions shape their sound.

innamorati.name: Innamorati
innamorati.bio: New duo of j:drive and TRIPS, appearing on RUSH's Funk Tribu day-and-night takeover at Knockdown Center.

supergloss.name: Supergloss
supergloss.bio: Berlin-based DJ and producer fusing 90s/00s acid, trance and techno; released the 'Space Office' EPs on Noom Records and runs the X-IZE label.

lovefoxy.name: LOVEFOXY
lovefoxy.bio: Berlin-born DJ and producer (Fania Folaji) playing high-energy 90s house; debuted with 'Burning Down the Sluthouse' on Nervous Records and founded the HOTLORD label.

x3butterfly.name: x3butterfly
x3butterfly.bio: Mexican-American DJ and producer from Detroit based in NYC; raw, high-BPM sets blending jungle, drum and bass, dubstep and techno, influenced by industrial pioneers.

crypture.name: Crypture
crypture.bio: Techno DJ billed on the TRIM/SILO 'SPEED' main-room night; fast, raw and powerful dance-floor approach; part of the TRIM/CRUD0 underground circuit

telesforo.name: Telesforo

second contact.name: Second Contact
second contact.bio: New York City-based DJ, Honey Trap mainstay and resident; sets move fluidly between downtempo, dark wave, EBM and progressive trance in long deliberate arcs.

amber valentine.name: Amber Valentine
amber valentine.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ playing disco, house and electro; resident for Susanne Bartsch and co-host of the PAT party with JD Samson; 2018 Brooklyn Nightlife Awards Best DJ.

franky rizardo.name: Franky Rizardo
franky rizardo.bio: Dutch DJ, producer and label boss; founder of the FLOW party brand and LTF Records; known for groove-driven house and tech house.

marco carola.name: Marco Carola
marco carola.bio: Naples-born DJ and producer; Music On label head and long-running Ibiza resident; key figure in techno's worldwide rise since the early 1990s.

mason collective.name: Mason Collective
mason collective.bio: Manchester-based DJ and production trio of Blair Suarez, Adam Myles and Omar Guedar; high-energy house and tech house grooves; run the MVSON party series and Whippin' label.

pablo romero.name: Pablo Romero
pablo romero.bio: Queens native and founder of Brooklyn's Archivio Record Shop; refined, gritty DJ sets blending deep house, techno and Latin rhythms; longtime TBA Brooklyn resident.

christian voldstad.name: Christian Voldstad
christian voldstad.bio: UK-raised, NYC-based DJ; Bespoke Musik resident and label manager; melodic low-end focused sets for All Day I Dream, Beachouse Ibiza and Brooklyn clubs.

chuwee.name: Chuwee
chuwee.bio: San Diego-born, Brooklyn-based DJ, producer and audio engineer; genre-fluid sets from rare grooves and house to 90s-inspired rhythms; NYC underground resident.

dreaminslow.name: DREAMINSLOW
dreaminslow.bio: Miami-raised, NYC-based DJ who changed his stage name from DREAMINSLOW to DREAM; blends techno, acid and dream trance in hypnotic club sets.

dawidu.name: Dawidu
dawidu.bio: Paris-born, nomadic DJ and founder of the Attention Spin! vinyl label; chameleon-like sets spanning house, electro, techno and left-field sounds.

farius.name: Farius
farius.bio: London-based DJ and producer Adam Turner on Anjunabeats and Enhanced Music; euphoric melody-driven trance and progressive; runs the QTS queer trance party.

feonix.name: Feonix
feonix.bio: New York-based DJ; techno, electro and disco sets at Brooklyn parties including GARAGE and Black2Black.

hovr.name: HOVR
hovr.bio: Berlin-based DJ and producer; dirty disco, funky techno and melodic sets; releases on Stil vor Talent.

hardt antoine.name: Hardt Antoine
hardt antoine.bio: London-based DJ and producer of French-Jamaican heritage; melodic house and techno; releases on Innervisions and Kompakt; runs the Reculture label.

nuts.name: NUTS
nuts.bio: Nice, France-based producer; hip-hop and G-funk influenced house with energetic live sets; released on Dawidu's Attention Spin! label.

oba+flip.name: OBA+FLIP
oba+flip.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ duo; hard-driving house and techno sets with space and groove; resident DJs for NYC's Zero and Armen Miran's Reborn Project

peter napoli.name: Peter Napoli
peter napoli.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ/producer since 2009; soulful driving house and techno with Latin percussion; behind the BRÜT and Voyage parties and Burning Man sets

rich rotas.name: Rich Rotas
rich rotas.bio: Bushwick-based house DJ; disco-driven sets at Brooklyn small clubs; plays Dead Letter No.9, Make Believe and Apollo Studio

skala.name: SKALA
skala.bio: Berlin-based producer, vocalist and DJ; piano-inflected melodic techno with heavy bass lines and airy melodies; releases on Stil vor Talent and Innervisions; Amaeo label co-founder

sissy.name: Sissy Elliott
sissy.bio: Brooklyn-based DJ and curator focused on art by and for the Black & Brown queer community; played Lincoln Center, Elsewhere, Mood Ring and Papi Juice

solarstone.name: Solarstone
solarstone.bio: British DJ and producer Richard Mowatt; founder of the Pure Trance movement and label; known for 'Seven Cities' and 'Solarcoaster'; active since the 1990s.

tommylogik.name: TOMMYLOGIK
tommylogik.bio: NYC-based producer and DJ Tommy G; blends melodic and progressive house; regular at SILO Brooklyn events; emerged from the underground hip-hop scene.

ale de tuglie.name: Ale De Tuglie
ale de tuglie.bio: Bari-born Italian DJ and producer; Music On resident known for groovy tech-house sets; toured with Marco Carola; releases on WHIPPIN, Futura and HALO Recordings.

brooke steele.name: Brooke Steele
